title: Louie Christopher Wee
text:
I am a Data Analyst and Researcher based in Calgary, Alberta.
 I am currently pursuing the Financial Risk Manager (FRM) designation.
 I recently completed a Post-Baccalaureate in Data Analytics and Marketing at Okanagan College
(Ranked #1 with GPA of 95%).
 I worked as a Research Officer at CTS Global Equity Group for 5 years,
focusing on market sentiment, risk management, and analysis of global equity markets.
 I enjoy traveling, food and sports.
